name: Leaf Node Gaussian Approximation
aliases: Spatial Clustering and Averaging (Leaf Node Approximation)
definition: A method to approximate VDB leaf nodes (512 voxels) with a single Gaussian primitive to reduce rendering complexity while maintaining spatial coherence.
summary: Leaf Node Gaussian Approximation reduces rendering complexity by representing each VDB leaf node as a single Gaussian primitive, distinguishing itself from higher LOD methods that subdivide nodes into smaller blocks.
